body:
As part of  https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/29742
I'm reviewing annotation to siderophore transport.

This one looks odd because
1. Mammals don't have siderophore transporters as far as I can tell
2. I don't see enterobactin or siderophores mentioned in  PMID:19590043
